Tributes to language martyrs pour in at Central Shaheed Minar
2024-02-21T10:39:20+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/tributes-language-martyrs-pour-central-shaheed-minar-3549241

On the occasion of

Amar Ekushey and International Mother Language Day

, people from all walks of life flocked to the Central Shaheed Minar late last night and early today to pay their respects to the martyrs of the historic Language Movement.
